run_train_dreambooth: run dreambooth fine-tuning of a diffusion model using colossalai distributed training
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that prepares instance and class images with tokenized prompts for model fine-tuning
parse_training_args: parse command-line arguments for dreambooth training including model paths, data dirs, and optimization settings
build_gemini_zero_dpp: build a GeminiDDP wrapper around a PyTorch model for ZeRO-style distributed data parallel training with colossalai
import_text_encoder_class: import the correct text encoder class (CLIPTextModel or RobertaSeriesModelWithTransformation) from a pretrained model path
